controls.label: Jog wheel
controls.summary: The platter. What it does depends on where you touch it and what you hold.

gestures.result: Scrub through the track. On a deck that is ready to scratch, the sound follows your hand.
Grabs the record. The sound holds still under your hand instead of running away.
Nudge the track a little earlier or later, without scratching.
Search through the track at twice speed, silently — no scratch sound, just fast motion through the track.

controls.label: SHIFT
controls.summary: The small SHIFT button beside the jog wheel. Hold it to unlock a second job for some of this deck's other controls.

gestures.result: Unlocks the alternate job of the [[deck.jog]], the transport [[deck.cue.transport]] button, and [[deck.sync]] on this deck. On its own it does nothing.

controls.label: PLAY / PAUSE
controls.summary: Starts and stops this deck.

gestures.result: Starts playback if the deck is paused, or pauses it if it is playing.

controls.label: CUE
controls.summary: The transport CUE button next to PLAY.

gestures.result: Does nothing.
Restarts the track from the very beginning. If it was already playing, it carries on playing from the start.

controls.label: CUE
controls.summary: The small CUE button under the channel fader. Nothing to do with the big CUE next to PLAY.

gestures.result: Sends this deck to your headphones, so you can hear it before the crowd does. Press again to take it out.

controls.label: BEAT SYNC
controls.summary: The SYNC button below the jog wheel.

gestures.result: Does nothing yet. Beat sync — matching this deck's tempo to the other deck automatically — is not implemented.
Cycles this deck's tempo range — how far the [[mixer.tempo]] slider can pull the speed up or down.

controls.label: LOAD
controls.summary: Sends the highlighted track from your library to this deck.

gestures.result: Loads the highlighted track from your library onto this deck, ready to play.

controls.label: HOT CUE
controls.summary: Switches this deck's performance pads to the HOT CUE page.

gestures.result: Switches this deck's pads to the HOT CUE page. On this page, pads 1-3 mute and unmute the drums, vocals, and instrumental; pads 4-8 do nothing.

controls.label: PAD FX1
controls.summary: Switches this deck's performance pads to the PAD FX1 page.

gestures.result: Switches this deck's pads to the PAD FX1 page. On this page, only [[deck.pad.1]] does anything — it toggles an echo effect; pads 2-8 do nothing.

controls.label: Pad 1
controls.summary: The first performance pad. What it does depends on the pad page.

gestures.result: Mutes or brings back the drums for this deck, once its stems are ready.
Turns a beat-synced echo on or off for this deck. Switching it off lets the echo tail ring out rather than cutting it dead.

controls.label: Pad 2
controls.summary: The second performance pad. Only does something on the HOT CUE page.

gestures.result: Mutes or brings back the vocals for this deck, once its stems are ready.

controls.label: Pad 3
controls.summary: The third performance pad. Only does something on the HOT CUE page.

gestures.result: Mutes or brings back the instrumental — everything except vocals and drums — for this deck, once its stems are ready.

controls.label: Pad 4
controls.summary: A performance pad. Sholto does nothing with it on either pad page.

controls.label: Pad 5
controls.summary: A performance pad. Sholto does nothing with it on either pad page.

controls.label: Pad 6
controls.summary: A performance pad. Sholto does nothing with it on either pad page.

controls.label: Pad 7
controls.summary: A performance pad. Sholto does nothing with it on either pad page.

controls.label: Pad 8
controls.summary: A performance pad. Sholto does nothing with it on either pad page.

controls.label: 4 BEAT / EXIT
controls.summary: The auto-loop button in the loop section.

gestures.result: Starts a loop from here, sized to a musical phrase. Press again to release it and carry on playing normally.

controls.label: 1/2X
controls.summary: Halves the current loop while one is running.

gestures.result: Halves the length of the loop that is currently running.

controls.label: 2X
controls.summary: Doubles the current loop while one is running.

gestures.result: Doubles the length of the loop that is currently running.

controls.label: TRIM
controls.summary: The input gain knob at the top of each channel strip. It is analogue — it sends no data to Sholto at all, so it never lights up here even though it does something real to the sound.

controls.label: HI
controls.summary: The top EQ knob on this channel.

gestures.result: Boosts or cuts the high end (cymbals, hi-hats) on this deck. All the way down mutes it completely.
While [[fx.onoff]] is held, this sets the drums' volume on this deck instead of the EQ.

controls.label: MID
controls.summary: The middle EQ knob on this channel.

gestures.result: Boosts or cuts the midrange (vocals, most instruments) on this deck. All the way down mutes it completely.
While [[fx.onoff]] is held, this sets the vocals' volume on this deck instead of the EQ.

controls.label: LOW
controls.summary: The bottom EQ knob on this channel.

gestures.result: Boosts or cuts the bass on this deck. All the way down mutes it completely — the classic bass-swap move.
While [[fx.onoff]] is held, this sets the instrumental — everything except vocals and drums — volume on this deck instead of the EQ.

controls.label: FILTER
controls.summary: The COLOR / FILTER knob on this channel.

gestures.result: Sweeps a filter across this deck. Left of centre is a low-pass sweep (muffled, underwater); right of centre is a high-pass sweep (thin, radio-like). Centre is no effect.

controls.label: Channel fader
controls.summary: This deck's volume fader in the mixer.

gestures.result: Sets this deck's level in the mix.

controls.label: Tempo
controls.summary: This deck's pitch/tempo slider.

gestures.result: Speeds up or slows down this deck's playback and pitch, to match another track.

controls.label: Crossfader
controls.summary: The horizontal fader at the bottom of the mixer.

gestures.result: Blends between deck 1 and deck 2 — full left is deck 1 alone, full right is deck 2 alone.

controls.label: MASTER LEVEL
controls.summary: The main output volume knob. Analogue, like TRIM — it sends nothing Sholto can see, so it never lights up here even though it changes what the crowd hears.

controls.label: MIC LEVEL
controls.summary: The microphone input level knob. Analogue — it sends no data to Sholto at all.

controls.label: Headphones MIX
controls.summary: Blends your headphones between the cued deck(s) and the master output. Analogue — it sends no data to Sholto at all.

controls.label: Headphones LEVEL
controls.summary: Your headphone volume knob. Analogue — it sends no data to Sholto at all.

controls.label: MASTER CUE
controls.summary: Sends the master mix, rather than a single deck, to your headphones.

gestures.result: Sends the master mix — what the crowd hears — to your headphones, so you can check it without picking a deck. Press again to take it out.

controls.label: Browse
controls.summary: The rotary knob for moving through your library. Turn it to scroll, press it to load or re-analyse.

gestures.result: Scrolls up or down your library list.
Does nothing on its own. Use LOAD 1 or LOAD 2 to send the highlighted track to a deck.
Re-analyses the highlighted track — hold for about a second to trigger it.

controls.label: FX ON/OFF (RELEASE FX)
controls.summary: The button above the BEAT FX section. Sholto repurposes it as a modifier rather than for its printed effect.

gestures.result: While held, the [[mixer.eq.hi]], [[mixer.eq.mid]] and [[mixer.eq.low]] knobs on either deck set the drums, vocals and instrumental levels instead of the EQ. On its own it does nothing.

controls.label: BEAT ◀
controls.summary: The left beatgrid-nudge button, shared by both decks.

gestures.result: Nudges the beatgrid slightly earlier, on whichever deck has Shift held, else whichever deck has a loop running, else deck 1.

controls.label: BEAT ▶
controls.summary: The right beatgrid-nudge button, shared by both decks.

gestures.result: Nudges the beatgrid slightly later, on whichever deck has Shift held, else whichever deck has a loop running, else deck 1.

controls.label: SMART CFX
controls.summary: Pioneer's automated combination-effect control. It sends MIDI, but Sholto does not implement this — turning or pressing it does nothing here.

controls.label: SMART FADER
controls.summary: Pioneer's automated crossfader-curve feature. It sends MIDI, but Sholto does not implement this — pressing it does nothing here.

controls.label: FX SELECT ▲
controls.summary: The upper of the two small arrow buttons in the BEAT FX column, for stepping to the next beat effect. Sholto does not implement this — pressing it does nothing here.

controls.label: FX SELECT ▼
controls.summary: The lower of the two small arrow buttons in the BEAT FX column, for stepping to the previous beat effect. Sholto does not implement this — pressing it does nothing here.

controls.label: LEVEL/DEPTH
controls.summary: The knob below the BEAT arrows, marked MIN to MAX, for setting how strongly the selected beat effect is heard. Sholto does not implement this — turning it does nothing here.

controls.label: CH SELECT
controls.summary: The small three-position switch above the BEAT FX column, marked 1 / 2 / 1&2, for choosing which deck (or both) the beat effect is applied to. Sholto does not implement this — moving it does nothing here.

controls.label: BACK
controls.summary: The small button left of the browse knob, labelled BACK for browsing your library in rekordbox. Sholto does not implement this — pressing it does nothing here.

controls.label: VIEW
controls.summary: The small button right of the browse knob, labelled VIEW for browsing your library in rekordbox. Sholto does not implement this — pressing it does nothing here.
